name: One repository
blurb: gh, git over HTTPS and the GitHub API, on one repository only.
guide: MWT reads the repository from each request's URL: the REST API's /repos/OWNER/NAME and git's /OWNER/NAME. A GraphQL query names it in its body, which MWT doesn't read as a repository: it is refused.
Requests that name no repository (your user, search) aren't covered: add another grant for them if a task needs them.

fields.purpose: GitHub, on {repository} only: gh, git over HTTPS and the GitHub API.
